Harry Dacre's song was published in 1892, marked Tempo di Valse: a waltz. Its sheet music prints three verses under one tune.

The chorus is marked "a little faster" than the verse, and it is the part almost everyone knows: "Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer, do".
